item.content:encoded: Oh, I am definitely against gratuitous crosslinking in mainlist articles. The only reason I would encourage crosslinks here is because it's a -J, and I think the concept would be better served if we knew at least some of the weird stuff that had happened in the places they were selling.

item.content:encoded:
I see the humor, and I kinda like it, but I think it doesn't go far enough. This is a -J, you can do things that wouldn't fly in a mainlist article.

The thing I would most like to see is some more overt references to known SCP's. If you are making any specific references, I think they are too subtle right now. Like, say that a house was affected by SCP-184 (but you know, really briefly). Heck, have one of the listings be SCP-1983! At this point, you are entertaining. I think you should go absurd.
